releases.name: Artifact Server v0.1.1
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Support Cloudflare Access OIDC login by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/43
* Fix the documented site deploy command by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/44
* Stabilize object-storage and MCP onboarding CI by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/59
* Update the Helm object-storage test fixture by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/60
* Stabilize Undici socket handling on macOS by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/61
* Stabilize CLI publication coverage test by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/62
* Relicense from AGPL-3.0-only to MIT OR Apache-2.0 by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/69
* Apply the combined dependency and action updates by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/70
* Clear the remaining dependency vulnerability alerts by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/71
* Support MCP OAuth through the configured OIDC issuer by @yalait in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/63
* Release version 0.1.1 and token-optional npm publication by @backnotprop in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/72

## New Contributors
* @yalait made their first contribution in https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/pull/63

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/plannotator/artifact-server/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
